steps.what: Define foodborne disease surveillance questions and configure source searches
Retrieve source matches for the specified foodborne parasitic disease queries
Identify relevant issues and analyze their implications for policies, studies and surveys

tasks.design: Configure source searches in the existing surveillance {OPS_SYSTEM}. Treat every match as a candidate; the epidemiologist verifies relevance and writes the policy and study implications in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source searching consumes time, but matches do not establish disease importance.
tasks.enabler_now: Epidemic intelligence services collect open-source signals.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish duplicate reports, weak evidence and genuine policy implications.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret disease significance and research consequences.

ambition.what: Review new source matches between scheduled issue reviews, with extra interpretation time budgeted.

tasks.altitude: Own surveillance coverage and evidence interpretation.

evidence.claim: EIOS provides open-source epidemic intelligence; this does not establish automatic foodborne policy analysis.
The proposed saved-search saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: The epidemiologist produces terms, parasite synonyms, geography, date window and source list in s1; query capture and initial testing occupy its 15 hours.
The source service produces linked items from those definitions; missing coverage returns to manual source search in s3.
Use native surveillance searches before adding a separate crawler.
Six focal hours per 100 baseline hours cover changed queries, coverage checks and duplicate handling.
This is issue-specific evidence review, excluding the separate program indicator dashboard.
research_questions: Can saved queries retain relevant disease reports without increasing screening time?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross 20 minus 6 upkeep gives central net 14%. Pilot range 0-4% discounts uncertain search share and additional noise; existing saved searches save zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define research proposal and assemble grant requirements, methods, budget and references
Write draft grant sections from the verified proposal packet

loop.purpose: Draft funder-specific narrative from the scientist's proposal
loop.input: Verified methods, budget, references, call and permitted disclosure scope
loop.output: Draft sections with source links and explicit gaps
loop.check: Epidemiologist checks each scientific claim, reference, budget statement and call requirement
loop.stop: One revision then manual writing; no invented commitments or citations
loop.why_not_simpler: A template structures fields but cannot express the specific scientific argument

steps.what: Finalize grant application and resolve scientific and institutional commitments

tasks.design: Start with the funder's template in {DOCS} and budget in {SPREADSHEET}. Where institutional and funder rules permit, use a bounded assistant for narrative drafting; final scientific commitments remain with people and submission stays in the existing authorization process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative assembly repeats, but research design and commitments remain specific.
tasks.enabler_now: Research report drafting capabilities can support an application-writing pilot.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific novelty, realistic methods and accurate resource commitments.
tasks.human_edge: Make and defend a credible research proposal.
tasks.altitude: Own proposal quality and methodological coherence.

reach.task: Map a proposal to call requirements

evidence.claim: Benchling supports study-report drafting; grant drafting suitability and savings are not demonstrated by that capability.
The digest reports fabricated bibliographic citations, supporting reference verification rather than reliance on generated sources.
The application-specific workflow and time shares are model assumptions.

assumptions: The epidemiologist produces aims, design, methods, verified references, budget facts, permitted commitments and call fields in s1; its 35 hours includes capture and staff consultation.
Existing research and finance staff supply their normal confirmations before finalization; any added assistance is counted separately.
If policy forbids drafting assistance or the packet is incomplete, write manually; assessor restrictions do not automatically establish applicant permissions.
Use the native template first and never upload confidential source material without approved access.
Five focal upkeep hours and two other-role support hours are additional per 100 baseline hours.
research_questions: Does verified drafting reduce effort after scientific and budget checks?

already_counted.description: Proposal design, source capture and budget consultation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=84; gross 16 minus 5 upkeep gives central net 11%. Conservative pilot range 0-5% allows revisions and policy limits; scientific planning and submission authority are not automated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and evaluate public health safety standards

steps.what: Plan and evaluate health safety standards through consultation and evidence assessment

tasks.design: Keep standard setting, consultation and evaluation with the epidemiologist and stakeholders using {DOCS}. Program indicator production is accounted for in the separate oversight task and creates no second saving here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standards depend on evidence quality, feasibility and affected people's needs.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing evidence and document tools support deliberation.
tasks.still_hard: Choose justified safety requirements and evaluate consequences.
tasks.human_edge: Balance scientific evidence and practical implementation.

evidence.claim: Health standard setting and stakeholder consultation retain full time in this design.

assumptions: This baseline is standards judgement and administration rather than duplicated indicator preparation.
Use existing documents; no new automation or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Scope of standards and approval responsibilities
research_questions: Is there a distinct repetitive administration workload outside program reporting?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Consultation, evaluation and implementation decisions remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research methods and procedures for medical use

steps.what: Design research methods and prepare validated observations and analysis specifications
Calculate specified research summaries with fixed reproducible analysis code
Evaluate medical applicability and present qualified methodological findings

tasks.design: Use existing analysis facilities in {DATA_PLATFORM} for explicitly specified calculations after manual study design and data preparation. The scientist checks outputs, determines medical applicability and presents conclusions through {DOCS}; no live clinical procedure is changed automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated calculations may be manual while study validity still requires expertise.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned deterministic research pipelines are established, although this study needs its own validation.
tasks.still_hard: Determine whether a method is valid and suitable for medical use.
tasks.human_edge: Design research and assess external validity.

ambition.what: Rerun a validated analysis after protocol-consistent data updates.

tasks.altitude: Own reproducibility and applicability of research methods.

evidence.claim: nf-core provides versioned, containerized and tested bioinformatics pipelines; this supports the reproducibility pattern, not suitability of a specific medical-method study.
The proposed fixed analysis and time effect are study-specific E1 assumptions.

assumptions: The epidemiologist creates participant or sample keys, measured variables, units, exclusions, missingness flags and analysis definitions in s1; its 45 hours includes source reconciliation and capture.
Code accepts only the specified schema and tested calculations; new outcomes, failed validation or method changes return to manual analysis design.
Use existing analysis software before building new infrastructure.
Eight additional focal hours cover code checks, changed definitions and reproducibility maintenance per 100 baseline hours.
This covers methodological experiments, not duplicated general disease investigation or communication drafting.
research_questions: Does the same specified analysis recur enough to justify ongoing validation?

already_counted.description: Study design, data capture and analysis specification

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross 20 minus 8 upkeep gives central net 12%. Pilot range 0-3% discounts unverified repeatability and substantial validation needs; already scripted analyses save zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Own disease evidence, methodological validity and defensible research proposals.
reach: Support research analysts with tested specifications
Work with health policy advisers on implementable standards
role.ambitious_version: An epidemiologist who repeats validated searches and calculations while retaining scientific design, policy judgement and institutional commitments.
